description: Greek Floods Web Map (historic flood events 1886-2022) is a hazard data portal run by University-based research team (Evelpidou et al., 2023, Climate) with web map by A. Liaskos. An interactive map of historic flood events in Greece from 1886 to 2022 (136 years), filterable by year, location, death toll and event name; the site also accepts contributions as CSV or Excel files with date, coordinates, location name and casualty fields. Coverage: Greece, 1886 to 2022. Formats and interfaces named: CSV. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated on the page; citation of Evelpidou et al. (2023) requested. Caveats: the event count is not stated on the page and a download route for the full data is not described; the record is a map application and the underlying table may need a request to the authors. It can support calibrating flood hazard and exposure studies of Greek infrastructure against past events. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: page text read; the data themselves were not downloaded.
